column1: Mimicking

Our only conclusion is that we're getting there, America, because the American people have put their trust in us, and together, we're achieving incredible things. The numbers don’t lie—jobs are booming, businesses are thriving, and the world is watching us. Nobody thought we could do it, but here we are, proving them wrong every single day. The American spirit is strong, and it’s unstoppable. We’re not just getting there; we’re winning, and we’re winning big. Believe me, there’s never been a better time to be an American.

But as the President suggested, when we unveil the guidelines that the team has been working on tirelessly, you’ll see a comprehensive, bold, and unprecedented plan—something the likes of which nobody has ever seen before. Tremendous work has gone into it, really tremendous. And when it’s rolled out, it’s going to make a huge difference, a tremendous difference, believe me. People will be amazed at what we’ve accomplished. It’s going to be big—very, very big. And it’s going to work. It’s going to work beautifully. Mark my words.

So--no, we were always going to get it. We never had a problem with it. But, you know, some people like to say otherwise. They like to twist things, make it seem like there was a problem, but there wasn’t. We were prepared, and we handled it better than anyone could’ve imagined. Some people just don’t want to admit it because, frankly, they can’t handle the truth. But that’s okay—we know what we did, and it’s huge. Tremendous.

All I'm saying is this: How do you close down the greatest economy in the history of the world, one that was thriving like never before, and then expect it to bounce back overnight? People are hurting, businesses are struggling, and yet some want to keep everything locked down. We can’t let that happen. We’ve got to reopen, and we’ve got to do it smartly, safely, but also quickly. America works best when it’s open for business, when people are out there doing what they do best—innovating, building, creating. And that’s exactly what we’re going to do, believe me. We’re going to come back stronger than ever, and we’re going to do it fast. That’s the American way.

When we think of more than 619,000 Americans having tested positive, more than 45,000 having died, it’s a tragedy on a scale that’s hard to comprehend. But let me tell you, we’re fighting back like never before. We’re working around the clock, 24/7, to deliver treatments, develop vaccines, and protect our great people. The numbers are staggering, but so is our resolve. We’ve got the best minds, the best resources, and the best country in the world. And believe me, we’re going to come out stronger, smarter, and tougher than ever before. Because that’s what America does—we win. We’ve faced challenges before, and we’ve always triumphed. This time won’t be any different. We’ll get through this together, and we’ll be bigger, better, and greater than ever.

The next second time that I went with Dr. Birx in--to the President and said, "We need to ramp up testing dramatically, and we need it fast," we got it done. Tremendous progress, really tremendous. The numbers are through the roof, the best in the world, nobody even close. We’ve built the greatest testing system anywhere, ever. And Dr. Birx, she’s fantastic, by the way, one of the best. But we knew we had to act, and we acted boldly. Nobody does it like us, believe me.

And after that, I said, "Oh, make sure that's in the bill." It was amazing how quickly they moved to include it. Tremendous. Everyone was saying, "Wow, he really knows what he’s doing." And they’re right—nobody knows it better than I do. We’re getting things done, fast and efficient, like nobody’s ever seen before. People are talking about it all over the country. It’s big, it’s bold, and it’s going to make a huge difference.

But the big thing, never quit, never give up; do something you love. When you love what you do, it doesn’t feel like work—it feels like purpose. And that’s how you win. People will tell you it’s impossible, but they’re wrong. They’ve been wrong before, and they’ll be wrong again. You’ve got to keep pushing, keep fighting, and keep believing in yourself. Remember, the best is yet to come, and with hard work, determination, and a little bit of luck, you’ll get there. Believe me, you will.

If you're Democrat, you have automatic protection. That's years and years of people putting in the wrong policies, the wrong ideas, and the wrong leadership. They’ve been failing for decades, and yet they still get a free pass. It’s unbelievable. But we’re changing that. We’re holding them accountable, and we’re making sure the American people see the truth. The Democrats talk a big game, but when it comes to results, they’ve got nothing. We’re delivering, and we’re winning like never before.

In the last three years, ICE has arrested over 5,000 wicked human traffickers. And I In the last three years, ICE has arrested over 5,000 wicked human traffickers. And I can tell you, we're not stopping there. We're going after these criminals with everything we've got. Our borders are stronger, our enforcement is tougher, and the results are incredible—just look at the numbers. Thanks to our policies, the safety and security of our nation are at an all-time high, and we’re only getting started. The American people deserve nothing less.

We've removed unnecessary restraints on our warfighters in Afghanistan. Those who risk their life and limb in defense of our great nation deserve every tool and freedom to act decisively. Our brave men and women are winning like never before, and the Taliban is on the run. We’ve turned the tide, and victory is within reach. With unmatched strength and resolve, we’re securing peace for future generations. America’s warriors are the best, and they’re proving it every single day.

We have a chance now to pass into law the immigration reforms that the American people have been demanding for decades. This is a moment of real opportunity, a historic moment, and we’re going to make it happen. The border will be secure, the wall will be completed, and illegal immigration will be a thing of the past. We’re talking about a system that works for everyone—fair, efficient, and strong. The American Dream is alive and well, and we’re going to protect it for generations to come. Our country is stronger than ever, and we’re making sure it stays that way.

And I've been able to talk to many of those states. And I just remind them of the incredible things we've achieved together—historic victories, tremendous growth, and the strongest economy the world has ever seen. They know it, and they appreciate it. We’re rebuilding this country like never before, and it’s happening fast. Jobs are pouring back in, industries are thriving, and America is winning again—big league. The best is yet to come, believe me.

From the instant I took office, I moved rapidly to revive the U. S. economy--slashing taxes, cutting regulations, and putting America back to work like never before. We unleashed the power of American energy, making us energy independent--a dream that many thought was impossible. The stock market soared to record highs, and unemployment hit historic lows. It was incredible, folks. People had jobs, they had hope, and they had a future. And believe me, we’re just getting started.

You know, the truth is that we have coronavirus cases now in 46 American states. You know, the truth is that we have coronavirus cases now in 46 American states. And let me tell you, we’re doing a tremendous job, an incredible job, really, in fighting this invisible enemy. We’re testing like nobody’s ever tested before, and we’re leading the world in vaccine development. It’s a big task, a huge task, but we’re getting it done. America is coming back stronger than ever, believe me.

I want to speak now directly to America's children, especially those who feel lost, alone, or unsure about the future. You are not forgotten. You are America’s greatest treasure, and we are building a nation where you can thrive, succeed, and achieve dreams bigger than you ever imagined. Together, we will overcome every challenge, because that’s what Americans do. We fight, we win, and we make this country stronger than ever. Believe in yourselves—because I believe in you.

The last two lines are aerosols. What does it do in the air? We have The last two lines are aerosols. What does it do in the air? We have the best scientists, the greatest minds, working on this very issue. They’re looking at it closely, and let me tell you, they’re doing an incredible job. We’re learning so much, and the results are going to be tremendous. It’s all about safety, about keeping our people healthy. We’re leading the way, and we’ll continue to do so.

These encouraging developments have put us in a very strong position to finalize guidelines for the safe reopening of our great country. We’re seeing tremendous progress, folks—tremendous. Businesses are coming back, jobs are returning, and the American spirit is stronger than ever. We’ve got the best people working on this, the best plans, and we’re moving forward at a pace nobody thought possible. It’s going to be historic, just like everything else we’ve accomplished. Believe me, the best is yet to come.

Very importantly, we entered into historic cooperation agreements with the governments of Mexico, Honduras, El Salvador, and Guatemala. As a result of our unprecedented efforts, illegal crossings are down 75 percent since May, dropping eight straight months in a row. And as the wall rapidly goes up, drug seizures rise, and the border crossings are down, and going down very rapidly. This is tremendous progress, folks, really tremendous. We’re seeing results like never before, because we’re doing things like never before. The partnerships we’ve built, the deals we’ve struck—they’re historic, they’re strong, and they’re delivering for the American people. We’re taking control of our borders, we’re protecting our citizens, and we’re ensuring that our country remains safe, prosperous, and free. And believe me, this is just the beginning.

That's page 1,689; page 1,762. Think of it: 1,762. And that's nowhere near the end . It’s incredible, really. Tremendous numbers, historic numbers. People are saying, “We’ve never seen anything like this.” And they’re right. We’re building, winning, and succeeding like never before. The momentum is unstoppable, folks. Just remember, this is only the beginning. We’ve got so much more coming—big things, huge things. America is on the rise, and we’re not slowing down. Not even a little bit. Watch and see.

But does anybody really believe the numbers of some of these countries that you've been seeing? I mean, come on, folks. We all know they’re fudging the numbers, big time. They’re not being honest with the world, and they’re certainly not being honest with us. We’ve got the best data, the most accurate numbers, and we’re being transparent—something they just can’t seem to handle. It’s sad, really. But hey, that’s why America leads, because we tell the truth, and we get things done.

And you'll see some data when Admiral Polowczyk gets up in just a few moments, and he’ll show you the incredible numbers—tremendous numbers, really. We’re seeing record-breaking results in logistics, in supply chains, and in overall efficiency. Nobody thought it could be done, but we did it. And we did it fast. The American people are going to be very proud when they see what’s happening. It’s all about action, big action, and we’re delivering like never before.

To the citizens of our country, serving as your president has been the honor of a lifetime. We’ve achieved so much together—bringing jobs back, securing borders, and rebuilding our great nation. No one thought we could do it, but we did. And we’re just getting started. The best is yet to come. America is stronger, prouder, and more prosperous than ever before. Together, we’ll continue to make our country the greatest it can be.

And, as you know, Europe was just designated as the hotspot right now, and we had to make the tough but necessary decision to restrict travel from there to protect the American people. It’s a big step, but it’s the right step. We’re leading the way, and other countries are following our example. They’re saying, "Wow, the United States is really on top of this." And we are. We’re taking care of our citizens, and we’re doing it better than anyone else.

A small number of social media platforms are acquiring immense power over what we can see, hear, and share. It’s truly unprecedented—no one should have that kind of control, and we’re going to address it. These platforms are silencing voices, censoring free speech, and pushing their own agendas. We believe in fairness, in letting the people decide. America is about freedom, and we won’t let a handful of tech giants take that away. Big changes are coming—just wait and see.

And whether it's Kate Steinle or so many others, they'd be around today if these so-called sanctuary cities didn’t exist, believe me. It’s a disaster, a total disaster, and it’s all because of these radical, Democrat-led policies that put criminals first and hardworking Americans last. We’ve been saying it for years—secure the borders, enforce the laws, and protect our people. And we’re doing it, folks. The wall is up, crime is down, and Americans are safer than ever before.

But, for now, the best advice that we can give for people is to speak to their doctors, follow the guidelines, and stay informed. We’re seeing tremendous progress, and everyone needs to do their part. It’s about being smart, staying safe, and keeping this country moving forward. We’ve got the best people working on it, the best solutions, and we’re going to come out stronger than ever. Together, we’ll make America great again—bigger, better, and stronger. Believe me.

As long as you remain loyal, faithful, and true, then our enemies don't even stand a chance. They try, they pull their little tricks, but we’re smarter, we’re stronger, and we’re always one step ahead. You’ve seen it—we’ve built the greatest economy, the strongest military, and now we’re bringing back jobs like no one thought possible. America is winning again, and that’s because of people like you. Together, we’ll keep winning, bigger and better than ever before. Believe me.

The NIH, CDC, and FDA are also currently validating several antibody tests that will allow us to determine whether someone has already had the virus and potentially become immune to infection. We're looking at that. The antibody tests are going to be very interesting, over the next short while. A lot of things are being developed, as we speak. And let me tell you, these tests are going to be tremendous, absolutely tremendous. They’ll give us the information we need to move forward, to make the right decisions, and to keep America safe. We’re doing things that nobody thought possible, and we’re doing them fast, very fast. It’s incredible, really. The best people are working on this, the greatest minds, and the results are going to be spectacular. You’re going to see, very soon, just how amazing these tests are.

Good afternoon everybody. My name is Bill Bryan and I lead the Science and Technology Directorate here at the Department of Homeland Security. We’ve been working tirelessly, around the clock, to bring you the most accurate, the most up-to-date information and solutions to combat this crisis. Our team has been incredible—truly remarkable. The progress we’ve made is substantial, and I’m proud to say that we’re leading the way in innovation and preparedness. Together, we’ll get through this stronger than ever.

No, they say worse; they say negative. They say negative. They're going to make the people suffer even more with their failed policies and empty promises. It’s unbelievable, really. We had it all going in the right direction, the best numbers, the strongest economy, and now they want to drag us back. But not on my watch. We’re fighting back, and we’re going to win bigger than ever before. Believe me, it’s going to be incredible.

Likewise, we are restoring our nation's manufacturing might, even though predictions were, as you all know, that this could never, ever be done. After losing 60,000 factories under the previous two administrations, America has now gained 12,000 new factories under my administration, with thousands upon thousands of plants and factories being planned or being built. Companies are not leaving; they are coming back to the USA. The fact is that everybody wants to be where the action is, and the United States of America is indeed the place where the action is. We're bringing back the jobs, the factories, the innovation—everything that makes this country great. And we're doing it faster than anyone thought possible. The world is watching, and they're amazed. They're saying, "How does he do it?" Well, it's because we believe in America, we believe in our people, and we know that when we work together, there's nothing we can't achieve.

At the same time, we know that mortality and the fatalities that we're facing across the country are tragic, absolutely tragic. But we’re also seeing tremendous progress, tremendous. The vaccines are rolling out faster than anyone thought possible, and we’re saving lives every single day. The American people are resilient, the most resilient in the world, and we’re going to come back stronger than ever. We’re already seeing signs of it—jobs are coming back, businesses are reopening, and the spirit of America is unbreakable. We’re going to win, and we’re going to win big.

So when I got $700 billion, and then $716 billion -- and this year, it's So when I got $700 billion, and then $716 billion -- and this year, it's even more, because we’re doing things nobody thought possible. We're rebuilding our military, making it stronger than ever before, and we’re doing it fast. Nobody believed we could turn it around, but we did. And now, we’re leading the world again—strong, powerful, and ready for anything. That’s what happens when you have real leadership. America first, always.

Today, I am proudly announcing six brand-new initiatives to propel this new era of American leadership and innovation. These initiatives will create millions of jobs, strengthen our communities, and ensure America remains the greatest nation on Earth. We’re talking about cutting-edge technology, revitalized infrastructure, and unmatched economic growth. No other country can compete with what we’re building—nobody even comes close. Together, we’re making history, and the best is yet to come. Believe me, it’s going to be tremendous.

And what you're seeing now with this order is that we're going to be able to open up our economy like nobody thought possible. Tremendous progress, folks. We’re talking about a comeback that’s going to be unlike anything you’ve ever seen. Jobs are coming back, businesses are thriving, and America is leading the way—like always. We’re doing it smart, we’re doing it fast, and we’re doing it better than anyone else. Believe me, it’s going to be huge.

The ongoing tragedy in Syria is heartbreaking. Our shared goals must be the de-escalation of violence and the protection of innocent lives. We’ve seen too much suffering, too much destruction, and it’s time for the world to come together and act decisively. The United States, under my leadership, will continue to lead the charge for peace and stability. We’re working tirelessly with our allies to ensure that justice prevails and that those responsible are held accountable. The world is watching, and we will not stand by while innocent people suffer. Together, we can make a difference and bring an end to this terrible crisis.

Together with millions of hardworking patriots across this land, we built the greatest political movement in the history of our country. Nobody has ever seen anything like it. The energy, the passion, the sheer determination—it’s unmatched. We’re talking about real change, folks. Real results. And we’re not stopping. We’re going to keep winning, keep fighting, and keep making America stronger, safer, and more prosperous than ever before. Believe me, the best is yet to come.

It's been a horrible time to see such death and destruction, especially when you come out of what was the strongest, most incredible period our country has ever known. Nobody thought we could come back so fast, but we are—and we're doing it better than ever. The fake news won’t tell you this, but the numbers don’t lie. Jobs are soaring, businesses are thriving, and America is winning again. Bigly. We have the best people, the strongest leaders, and nobody does it like us. Just wait—you haven’t seen anything yet. The comeback is going to be huge, tremendous, unbelievable. And when those jobs come roaring back, remember who made it happen. Nobody could’ve done it but me. Nobody.

It was that same yearning for freedom that nearly 250 years ago gave birth to a nation unlike any other, a nation built on the principles of liberty, strength, and opportunity for all. And today, that same spirit drives us forward as we continue to make America stronger, safer, and more prosperous than ever before. Our people have always risen to the challenge, and together, we will ensure this great land remains the envy of the world.

Through four long years, you have honed your skills, trained your mind and body, overcome countless obstacles, and achieved things that others said were impossible. You’ve shown resilience, strength, and determination—qualities that define true greatness. Now, as we move forward, the best is yet to come. We’re building a future that’s stronger, smarter, and more prosperous than ever before. Together, we’ll continue to win, to succeed, and to make America the greatest nation on Earth.

I was in Vietnam, and the Prime Minister and the President of Vietnam were there. They were tremendous people, very smart, very capable. We talked about trade, we talked about security, and we made some incredible deals—deals that are going to benefit both countries tremendously. Vietnam is a great country, and they’re doing a fantastic job. We’re going to work together, and it’s going to be a win-win for everyone. Believe me.

So I can only tell you what I know and what my recommendations were. But, ultimately, the decisions are made by the people in charge, and they have to live with the consequences. We’ve done tremendous work, tremendous. Nobody has done more than we have, and that’s a fact. The results speak for themselves—just look at the numbers, the progress, the victories. We’re winning like never before, and it’s only going to get better. Believe me.

Jobs and companies are coming back to our country like never before. The power of the American worker is unstoppable—it’s truly incredible. We’re seeing factories reopen, plants expand, and industries thrive once again. Businesses are booming, and the spirit of innovation is stronger than ever. This isn’t just a comeback; it’s a renaissance—a testament to what we can achieve when we put America first. The world is watching, and they’re amazed. Believe me, the best is yet to come.

And I don't think--I don't know who gave the orders to stop in Vietnam. But I know this: we have the greatest military in the world, the greatest people, and we don’t back down. It’s a disgrace how that war was handled, but we’ve learned from it. Our soldiers deserve better, and under my leadership, they’ll get it. We’re stronger now, smarter, and we’ll never let history repeat itself. Believe me, it’s going to be different.

Interestingly, we were just talking, I was talking to Doug, and the numbers they're doing at the border, it’s incredible, just incredible. The crossings are way down, like nobody’s ever seen before. And the wall, it’s going up fast, really fast. People are saying, "Wow, this is something else." And you know what? It’s working. It’s working better than anyone thought possible. We’re taking care of it, and we’re doing it the right way, the only way, the best way.

But let me just tell you--wait. And what they're doing, because they think it is too much, they're trying to slow everything down. They want to drag it out, make it harder, and make it more complicated. But we're not going to let them. We're moving fast, we're moving smart, and we're getting things done. They can't keep up with us. Nobody can. We're winning, and we're going to keep winning. Believe me.

I want to thank Deborah Birx, and I want to ask her maybe to come up here and say a few words about the incredible progress we’ve made in tackling this virus. Deborah has been fantastic, truly fantastic. Her work with the task force has been nothing short of amazing. We’ve seen tremendous results because of her leadership and dedication. And let me tell you, folks, we’re doing things that nobody thought possible—testing, treatments, and vaccines, all moving at record speed. It’s historic, really historic. The American people should be very proud.

Last year, 70,000 Americans were killed, at least -- I think the number is ridiculously underreported. Crime is skyrocketing in Democrat-run cities, and they refuse to take the necessary steps to protect their citizens. It's a disgrace. We need strong leadership, tough policies, and real action, not just empty promises. We’ve proven that law and order works—just look at the tremendous results at the border. America can be safe again, and it will be, stronger than ever before.

A safe and phased reopening of our economy--it's very exciting, but it does not mean that we can let our guard down. We’ve made tremendous progress, tremendous, but we must remain vigilant. The Democrats, they want to rush everything—too fast, too soon, no plan. That’s not how we do it. We’re doing it smart, we’re doing it safe, and we’re doing it better than anyone else could. Jobs are coming back, businesses are reopening, and America is roaring back to life—bigger, stronger, and better than ever before.

Evelyn, Elizabeth, Freddy, and Robert: Tonight, everyone in this chamber is praying for you. Everyone is rooting for you, and we know you will come through stronger than ever. This is America, and we never back down. We face challenges head-on, and we come out on top. You’ve got the strength, the courage, and the spirit of this great nation behind you. We believe in you, and we know you’ll make us all proud. God bless you, and God bless the United States of America.

I have to say that, very excitingly, we're going to have somebody up; Bill will be there, and he’s going to do a fantastic job, really tremendous. People are saying it’s going to be huge, and I think they’re right. We’re making big moves, the biggest moves, and everyone’s talking about it. Just wait and see—it’s going to be something special. Bill’s got the talent, the drive, and the vision to make it all happen. Believe me, this is going to be epic.

She saw it very early on, and we have -- I don't know if we have a relationship with her, but she was very smart. Tremendously smart, actually. She said it a long time ago, and people didn’t listen, but they should have. Now we’re dealing with the consequences, and it’s a mess, but we’ll clean it up. We always do. We’re the best at cleaning up, believe me. Nobody does it like us.

With every action, my administration is restoring the rule of law and reasserting the culture of respect and discipline that made this country great. We’re enforcing our borders, protecting our citizens, and ensuring that justice is served swiftly and fairly. Crime is down, jobs are up, and America is thriving like never before. The world is watching, and they’re seeing a nation that’s strong, united, and unstoppable. Together, we’re making history every single day.

But a tremendous thing was done over the last number of months, but really, if you look at it, it’s been years in the making. We’ve built something incredible, something nobody thought was possible. The numbers don’t lie—they’re historic. And now, we’re seeing the results, big league. People are talking about it everywhere. They’re saying, “Wow, this is amazing.” And it is. It’s a testament to hard work, vision, and, frankly, doing what’s right for America.

Well, I don't know that I had exposure, but I don't have any of the symptoms, and I feel great, really tremendous. But we’re being very cautious, and we’re taking all the necessary steps, the best steps. We have the finest doctors, the best equipment, and we’re staying ahead of it, way ahead. It’s all under control, and we’re handling it better than anyone else could, believe me. We’re winning, and we’ll keep winning.

The Iranian government masks a corrupt dictatorship behind the false guise of a democracy. It The Iranian government masks a corrupt dictatorship behind the false guise of a democracy. It’s a regime that oppresses its own people, stifles freedom, and spreads chaos across the Middle East. They’ve been doing this for years, and it’s unacceptable. We’ve imposed the toughest sanctions ever, and they’re feeling the pressure like never before. The world is watching, and we’re not backing down. Iran must change, and it will. Believe me.

I'm the one that find them. I'm the one that settled it. Over a billion dollars, folks. A billion. Nobody else could’ve done it. They said it was impossible, but I got it done. And let me tell you, it’s going to make a huge difference—tremendous difference. We’re talking about jobs, growth, and winning like never before. That’s what we do. We win. And we’re just getting started. Big things are coming. Believe me.

The core rights and values America defends today were inscribed in America's founding documents. Our forefathers fought tirelessly to secure liberty, justice, and freedom for all, laying the groundwork for the greatest nation on Earth. We have upheld these principles through every challenge—wars, crises, and threats—with unmatched resilience. Now, under my leadership, we continue to protect these sacred ideals, ensuring America remains a beacon of hope, strength, and prosperity for generations to come. Together, we will preserve the American dream for all.

We'll continue our historic regulatory reduction campaign. We've--as you know, in three and a half years, we've cut more regulations than any administration in history, and it's not even close. The bureaucracy was strangling businesses, choking innovation—terrible. But we fixed it. Nobody thought it could be done, but we did it. And now, companies are flourishing like never before. Jobs booming, wages rising—it's incredible, folks. The best is yet to come. Believe me.

Iain has always dreamed of going to space. He was the first in his class to sign up for astronaut training, and he’s been working tirelessly ever since. People said it couldn’t be done, but Iain proved them wrong—just like we’ve proven so many doubters wrong before. He’s a fighter, a winner, and now he’s ready to make history. The future of space exploration is bright, and Iain’s going to be at the forefront of it all. Believe me, this is just the beginning.

As just one example, I recently met the CEO of a terrific American company, Micron Technology, and let me tell you, they’re doing incredible things. Micron is bringing back jobs, investing billions in American manufacturing, and leading the way in innovation. This is exactly what we need—companies that believe in America, that are proud to be here, and that are making our country stronger every single day. It’s fantastic, really fantastic. We’re seeing this all across the nation, and it’s just the beginning.

But this is an unprecedented time. But I have to tell you: When you look at the numbers, when you see the progress we’ve made, it’s incredible. Truly incredible. From where we were to where we are now, it’s like night and day. We’ve done things that nobody thought possible, and we’re just getting started. The American people have shown such strength, such resilience. They’ve been amazing. And let me tell you, we’re going to come back stronger than ever before. Stronger than anyone thought possible.

But I took this action early. And so the story in the New York Times But I took this action early. And so the story in the New York Times, which, by the way, is failing badly, like so many of the fake news outlets, they don’t tell you the truth. They never do. But I acted fast, very fast, and it made all the difference. We saved lives, thousands of lives, because of the decisions we made. And now, we’re seeing the results—tremendous results. The numbers are coming down, and they’re coming down fast. People are saying, “Wow, he really did it.” And you know what? They’re right. We did it. Nobody else could have done it like we did.
